channel.title: Ratchet — engineering notes
channel.description: Notes from building an effect gate for AI agents.

item.title: Every health check was green and the standby was 590 MB behind
item.description: A Postgres standby stopped applying WAL for 34 minutes while every health check returned 200. Why replay_lag reads zero on a broken replica.

item.title: Fixing an availability defect caused a twelve-minute outage
item.description: Scaling the control plane from one machine to two pushed a 256MB Postgres into an OOM loop. The connection budget nobody had written down.

item.title: A planned failover left us with two primaries
item.description: A planned Postgres failover promoted a node, failed its health check, gave up, and restarted the old primary. Twenty-five minutes down, no data lost.

item.title: What happens when step five fails
item.description: A booking agent completes four steps and the payment declines. A retry loop fires a hundred charges. Two failures, run against the live service, with the transcripts.

item.title: Your idempotency keys are broken on macOS
item.description: Two machines, the same idempotency key, both authorised to charge the same card. The cause is four lines of Unicode.
